title: Security and tenant-isolation hardening gate

environment.profile: local acceptance on Darwin arm64; synthetic fixtures only; AC03 replayed by orchestrator without sandbox restrictions

BIO-OPS-006-AC01.finding: The whole-system threat model covers authentication, authorization, tenant routing, biometrics, card lifecycle, document parsing, webhooks and offline caches with controls and residual boundaries.

BIO-OPS-006-AC02.finding: The executable ledger check finds no defect explicitly marked open at Critical or High severity; approved future scope boundaries remain disclosed.

BIO-OPS-006-AC03.finding: The fail-closed gate executed seven named cross-tenant negative integration tests in an unrestricted runner: total 7, executed 7, passed 7, failed 0, skipped 0.

BIO-OPS-006-AC04.finding: Mandatory gitleaks current-tree and full-history scans are clean and fail closed when the pinned scanner is unavailable; native allowlisting is limited to exact synthetic fixtures and mutation proof rejects an unlisted credential.

BIO-OPS-006-AC05.finding: All direct production application logging is confined to two audit sinks whose emitted values cross SafeLogValue; no production console/debug writes or sensitive log-template vocabulary was found.

commands.result: PASS unrestricted on e50d3f6 (7/7; local sandbox replay unavailable because VSTest socket creation is denied)
PASS (14/14; gitleaks scanned 1,273 commits / 134.36 MB with no leaks)

disclosures: Shared HMAC actor provenance remains the accepted interim mechanism under ADR-0006, not real person authentication or separation of duties.
Real device enrolment remains responsible for provisioning mobile device secrets.
The mandatory current-tree and history secret scans conservatively duplicate full-history work; this is a non-blocking gate-efficiency issue.

final_acceptance.reason: AC01-AC05 have executable, commit-bound evidence. Nine review rounds closed the false-success tenant test gate and three unsafe scanner designs; both required reviewers pass the final evidence and no unresolved Critical or High finding remains.
